verdict.rationale: Drata documents the building blocks of a compliance program: controls with requirement mappings, a Policy Center with policy versioning, an Evidence Library, audits, monitoring tests and frameworks. Community reports show clients deploying it specifically for SOC 2, with personnel showing as compliant or noncompliant in the dashboard. However, nothing in the pack explicitly shows a built-in SOC 2 framework with Trust Services Criteria controls, Type I versus Type II audit workflows, prebuilt required-policy templates, or auditor evidence requests. Missing for 10: explicit SOC 2 framework and Trust Services Criteria control library, Type I and Type II audit support, required-policy templates, auditor evidence-request workflow.
